label: D32-perangkat-tambahan-sebelum-akun
decision: Until accounts, holder contact matching and memberships exist, what should POST /v1/enrollments do when a device presents the identity of a registered physical card, especially when another device already holds an active card instance for that same physical card?

candidates.description: Any device presenting a registered card identity gets a PROVISIONING card instance, as the tracer does today; ownership checks arrive with accounts.

The first device to enrol a physical card gets PROVISIONING; other devices get 409 ENR-ALREADY-CLAIMED while an active card instance exists for that card, until memberships exist. The same device may enrol again after deleting its card.
The first device gets PROVISIONING; additional devices get a PENDING_APPROVAL card instance that an operator CLI command can approve or reject, until memberships and security codes exist.
Every card enrolment becomes PENDING_APPROVAL until accounts and holder matching exist; an operator CLI command approves; the lab seeding approves automatically.

priorities: 1) Never grant access more widely than the SDD target model would (ADR-0004: card possession alone is weak proof; additional holders need the owner's code or an approval). 2) Keep the first enrolment and the lab end-to-end flow usable without accounts or an admin portal. 3) Converge naturally onto the SDD 8.4.1 outcomes when accounts land, so later work only adds checks. 4) Minimal interim code.
requirements: A second device that only had brief physical access to an already-enrolled card cannot obtain an active credential without an additional check.
The first enrolment of a registered card can complete end to end without accounts or an admin portal.
The interim outcome maps directly onto one of the SDD 8.4.1 outcomes (PRIMARY, PENDING_APPROVAL, MEMBER_CANDIDATE) so that later account work only adds checks.
